description: The line plot illustrates how the performance metric minFDE₂₀ (unitless, lower is better) changes as the “Ratio” of the in-context pool size varies from 0.1 to 1.0, comparing five different methods: TrajICL (blue circles, solid line), Head Tuning (orange circles, solid line), FT (green circles, solid line), LoRA 16 (red circles, solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple circles, solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Ratio,” is linear and ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The y-axis, labeled “minFDE₂₀ (←),” is linear and spans from 0.8 to 1.3 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. TrajICL starts at approximately 0.90 at Ratio=0.1, remains relatively flat around 0.88–0.89 until Ratio=0.8, then slightly declines to 0.86 at Ratio=1.0. Head Tuning begins at 1.34 at Ratio=0.1 and steadily decreases to 1.12 at Ratio=1.0. FT starts at 1.15, drops to 1.00 at Ratio=0.6, then falls sharply to 0.80 at Ratio=1.0. LoRA 16 begins at 1.22, declines to 1.05 at Ratio=0.6, then levels off near 0.95 at Ratio=1.0. LoRA 64 starts at 1.21, decreases to 1.02 at Ratio=0.6, and continues to 0.94 at Ratio=1.0. All methods show declining or stable performance trends as the ratio increases, with FT exhibiting the steepest final drop.
